text: The consumer reads `field.default` in two places. I’ll switch those reads to `dump_default` and make `load_default`/`dump_default` the canonical field attributes. The old constructor arguments and properties will remain available as deprecated aliases.

arguments.command:
python - <<'PY'
p='host/src/marshmallow/fields.py'
s=open(p).read().replace(':param default: If set,', ':param dump_default: If set,').replace(':param missing: Default deserialization', ':param load_default: Default deserialization').replace('If ``missing=None`` and', 'If ``load_default=None`` and')
s=s.replace('    :param metadata: Extra information to be stored as field metadata.','    :param metadata: Extra information to be stored as field metadata.\n    :param missing: Deprecated alias for ``load_default``.\n    :param default: Deprecated alias for ``dump_default``.')
s=s.replace('        output data. This parameter replaced both ``load_from`` and ``dump_to``.','        output data. This parameter replaced both ``load_from`` and ``dump_to``.\n\n    .. versionchanged:: 3.13.0\n        Replace ``missing`` and ``default`` with ``load_default`` and ``dump_default``.')
s=s.replace('        default: typing.Any = missing_,\n        missing: typing.Any = missing_,','        load_default: typing.Any = missing_,\n        dump_default: typing.Any = missing_,\n        default: typing.Any = missing_,\n        missing: typing.Any = missing_,',1)
s=s.replace('        self.default = default\n', '''        if default is not missing_:
            warnings.warn(
                "The 'default' argument to fields is deprecated. "
                "Use 'dump_default' instead.",
                RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning,
                stacklevel=2,
            )
            if dump_default is missing_:
                dump_default = default
        if missing is not missing_:
            warnings.warn(
                "The 'missing' argument to fields is deprecated. "
                "Use 'load_default' instead.",
                RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning,
                stacklevel=2,
            )
            if load_default is missing_:
                load_default = missing
        self.dump_default = dump_default
        self.load_default = load_default
''',1)
s=s.replace('# If allow_none is None and missing is None', '# If allow_none is None and load_default is None').replace('self.allow_none = missing is None if allow_none is None else allow_none','self.allow_none = load_default is None if allow_none is None else allow_none').replace('if required is True and missing is not missing_:', 'if required is True and load_default is not missing_:').replace('raise ValueError("\'missing\' must not be set for required fields.")', 'raise ValueError("\'load_default\' must not be set for required fields.")').replace('        self.missing = missing\n','')
s=s.replace('<fields.{ClassName}(default={self.default!r}, ', '<fields.{ClassName}(dump_default={self.dump_default!r}, ').replace('missing={self.missing}, allow_none=', 'load_default={self.load_default}, allow_none=')
s=s.replace('default = self.default', 'default = self.dump_default').replace('_miss = self.missing\n            return _miss() if callable(_miss) else _miss', 'load_default = self.load_default\n            return load_default() if callable(load_default) else load_default')
s=s.replace('    # Properties\n', '''    # Properties

    @property
    def default(self):
        """Deprecated alias for :attr:`dump_default`."""
        warnings.warn(
            "The 'default' attribute of fields is deprecated. Use 'dump_default' instead.",
            RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning,
            stacklevel=2,
        )
        return self.dump_default

    @default.setter
    def default(self, value):
        warnings.warn(
            "The 'default' attribute of fields is deprecated. Use 'dump_default' instead.",
            RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning,
            stacklevel=2,
        )
        self.dump_default = value

    @property
    def missing(self):
        """Deprecated alias for :attr:`load_default`."""
        warnings.warn(
            "The 'missing' attribute of fields is deprecated. Use 'load_default' instead.",
            RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning,
            stacklevel=2,
        )
        return self.load_default

    @missing.setter
    def missing(self, value):
        warnings.warn(
            "The 'missing' attribute of fields is deprecated. Use 'load_default' instead.",
            RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning,
            stacklevel=2,
        )
        self.load_default = value
''',1)
s=s.replace('        default: typing.Any = missing_,\n        only:', '        dump_default: typing.Any = missing_,\n        only:').replace('super().__init__(default=default, **kwargs)', 'super().__init__(dump_default=dump_default, **kwargs)')
s=s.replace('        self.missing = constant\n        self.default = constant', '        self.load_default = constant\n        self.dump_default = constant')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='consumer/marshmallow_jsonschema/base.py'
s=open(p).read().replace('field.default', 'field.dump_default')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
PYTHONPATH=host/src:consumer python -m pytest host/tests -q > /tmp/host-tests.log 2>&1; tail -40 /tmp/host-tests.log
